verdict.rationale: Navan's own docs show it ships configurable policy and approval workflows ('Unlimited policy and approval workflows'). Its MCP docs describe transactions being flagged against policy, with routing to an approver ('why a transaction was flagged, who needs to approve it, and what policy applies'), and category-specific policies such as rideshare and hotel policy limits. That supports exception-based review. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that in-policy expenses auto-approve without human touch, documentation of limits varying by role and context, in-depth policy-builder docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
